CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_date_v2(v text)
 RETURNS date
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF v IS NULL OR v !~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 RETURN left(v,10)::date;
EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_datetime_format OR datetime_field_overflow THEN RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_stamp_v2(v text)
 RETURNS timestamp with time zone
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF v IS NULL OR v !~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T.*(Z|[+-]\d{2}:\d{2})$' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 RETURN v::timestamptz;
EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_datetime_format OR datetime_field_overflow THEN RETURN NULL;
END $function$
